name: refkit
description: License-aware reference search for creative work: find images, art, textures, audio and text across open sources, with a use verdict and attribution line per result.

interface.shortDescription: License-aware reference search for creative work
interface.longDescription: Search museums, Wikimedia Commons, Openverse, Poly Haven, Project Gutenberg and more for images, art, textures, audio and text. Every result carries its license, a verdict for your intended use, and the attribution line when one is required.
defaultPrompt: Find CC0 forest textures I can ship in a game
Gather public-domain storm paintings for a moodboard
Can I use this Wikimedia Commons photo in an ad?
